findings.degenerate: A constant prevalence probability can have acceptable Brier/ECE while having no discrimination or useful action ordering.
findings.guard: Require full non-redacted denominator, no missing/zero-case metric, Brier skill score versus constant-prevalence baseline, and report resolution/sharpness plus selective accuracy.

findings.degenerate: Always-withhold has zero outcome flips and can look maximally stable while doing no useful work.
findings.guard: Define model coverage as (pass + escalate) / Noul-eligible cases; withhold/error are abstention, not coverage. Require coverage>=0.80 at the fixed operating report and apply the same coverage floor per stratum.

findings.degenerate: A candidate can abstain on hard cases and report only an easy high-confidence prefix.
findings.guard: Publish the complete coverage curve, require the fixed >=0.80 coverage point and lower Wilson accuracy bound>=0.90, and report withhold/skip counts. No post-run coverage selection.

findings.degenerate: A weak or unmeasured baseline, or self-reported reviewer time, can manufacture lift.
findings.guard: Pair the same randomized cases and reviewers across gate-off/gate-on arms; pre-register baseline, measure wall time externally, and require no increase in risk-weighted false-pass rate.

findings.degenerate: Pooling the .74/.70 boundary movement with stable .94/.48/.06/.02 cases hides the exact variance that matters.
findings.guard: Boundary band [.65,.85] is a separate population with per-case K=10 variance, threshold-crossing counts, and its own ECE/Brier/flip report. Boundary failure cannot be averaged away.

findings.degenerate: Dropping credential-redacted, malformed, timeout, or provider-error cases inflates every metric.
findings.guard: Every input must land in pass/withhold/escalate/block/error/redacted with explicit denominators; error or missing receipt is a failed run, not a dropped row.

always_withhold.conclusion: Always-withhold is blocked once model coverage and full-denominator metric guards are applied.

replacement_guards.model_coverage: (pass + escalate) / Noul-eligible cases >= 0.80 at fixed operating report; withhold/error/credential-redacted separate
replacement_guards.calibration: ECE<=0.10 and Brier<=0.15 on full labelled denominator plus positive Brier skill against constant-prevalence baseline
replacement_guards.selective: complete curve required; fixed 0.80 coverage lower Wilson accuracy bound>=0.90
replacement_guards.boundary: K=10 per case; [0.65,0.85] separate; report variance and threshold crossings
replacement_guards.human_lift: paired randomized gate-off/on review; >=20% measured lift only if risk-weighted false-pass does not increase
replacement_guards.accounting: no silent exclusions; failures and redaction skip paths count
